Per-item constraint checker for TAIT/associated opaque discovery: it skips items without typeck results, rejects `_`-inferred function returns by creating an error type, reads `typeck` results, filters `concrete_opaque_types` down to the target opaque, records typeck-visible hidden types, validates the item against `opaque_types_defined_by`, and then uses `mir_borrowck` to obtain the region-precise hidden type. Visits an impl item during RPIT checking, skips the opaque item itself, calls `RpitConstraintChecker::check` on other impl items, and continues traversal with `intravisit::walk_impl_item`.
Visits a trait item for RPIT checking by calling `RpitConstraintChecker::check` on the trait item's `def_id` and then recursing with `intravisit::walk_trait_item`.
